content.en: Inflation represents a **persistent rise** in the average price level of a basket of goods and services. It is not merely a price increase in a single commodity but a broad-based phenomenon. In the context of the **Indian Economy**, inflation is monitored to ensure that the **purchasing power** of the currency remains stable, which is vital for sustainable economic growth.
